name: Ciarán Walsh
headline: 36, backend engineer, Galway
description: Ciarán, a backend engineer in Galway, has lived alone in the same small stone house for eight years and works from home for a Dublin software firm. He spends his weekends single-handed sailing his aging boat and can fix most of its machinery himself. He keeps his neighbours at a polite distance, but every Friday he silently replaces the broken step on the footbridge near his house.
